title: Unlock All Flags
script:
local flags = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Flags
local listofFlags = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer.PlayerGui.Main.Inventory.ItemsFrame.Items.Flags

for i,v in next, flags:GetDescendants() do
    if v.Name:find("Flag") and v:isA("Model") then
        local flag = Instance.new('StringValue')
        local name = v.Name:gsub('Flag', '')
        flag.Name = name
        flag.Parent = game.Players.LocalPlayer.Inventory.Flags 
    end
end

task.wait(1)

for i,v in next, listofFlags:GetChildren() do
    if v:isA("ImageButton") then 
        local button = v 
        button.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
            warn('hitler')
            game.Players.LocalPlayer.EquippedFlag.Value = v.Name
        end)
    end
end
